ctx.x: Did he train Buck and Bubbles in the same way?

I don't think so, no. No, he bought Buck and Bubbles from Ramon Navarro, see, they were under contract to Ramon Navarro, that's what he told us, and he bought the contract, see? Buck and Bubbles used to make them little movies, you know. When they was children, you see.
They was in his act. Nat Nazarra had a -- he was a world famous act, you know, Nat Nazarra and Sons, see. He had five sons, see? They had a balancing act, see?
